text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for being here, everyone! Here's one last song!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's Silence Suzuka! Gosh, she's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: What's she doing in a concert, though? A winning concert I could understand, but this?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, this looks fun! We have time, why don't we watch?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: …I'm good. Concerts are for star runners.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Watching is only gonna remind us that with our records, we'll never get to sing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's wrong!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This is us asking everyone to join us for a concert where we can all express our gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As runners, we aspire to be in concerts. Because most of the time, a concert means a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We have to win an intense race for the right to stand in the spotlight. That's why it's so glamorous… why we dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But what about the girls who don't make it to center stage? They train just as hard as anyone, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We all work so hard at singing, dancing, and training in the hopes of one day performing in front of our fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Don't get me wrong—I love winning concerts! They're why I set my sights on the stage in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But I think it'd be amazing to have just one concert at the end of each year where everyone can thank their fans with their own singing and dancing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Don't you want to let your fans know how you feel? Directly, with your own unique voice?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's why we're here today—we want you to join us, and we hope you can hear that in our singing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Together, we can bring back the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, so do you mind if we stop by? I, um… might want to sing with them.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: N-not like seriously or anything! Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: …Just for a little.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Error. Yet again, their singing has…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I…
